data.name: Razik
data.gender_notes: Razik is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Someone who is given the knowledge and wisdom by Allah. The name Razik carries the meaning “Wise, Intelligent” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Pashto. Parents who choose Razik usually hope their child will grow to embody wise, intelligent and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A person who is deeply connected to Allah and has a great understanding of the divine
data.etymology: Razik belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Wise, Intelligent.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Razik total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.

in_arabic.name: رازق
in_arabic.meaning: الله يرزق عباده، يعني من يرزق الناس و يعطيهم الرزق
in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم الله الرزاق، يعني الذي يرزق عباده و يعطيهم الرزق الوفير، و هو من أسماء الله الحسنى، و يدل على قدرة الله تعالى على رزق جميع خلقه، و هو اسم الفاعل من رزق يرزق فهو رازق

in_urdu.name: رازق
in_urdu.meaning: اللہ جو اپنے بندوں کو رزق دیتا ہے، فراوانی دینے والا
in_urdu.long_meaning: اللہ تعالیٰ کے ناموں میں سے ایک نام، جس کا مطلب ہے کہ وہ اپنے بندوں کو رزق فراہم کرنے والا ہے، یہ نام رزق دینے کی صفت کو ظاہر کرتا ہے، جو کہ اسلامی تقویم میں اہم ہے

in_hindi.name: रज़िक
in_hindi.meaning: ईश्वर जो अपने सेवकों को जीविका प्रदान करता है
in_hindi.long_meaning: यह अल्लाह के सुंदर नामों में से एक है, जिसका अर्थ है जो अपने सेवकों को जीविका प्रदान करता है, यह नाम जीविका देने की विशेषता को प्रकट करता है, जो इस्लामी परंपरा में महत्वपूर्ण है

in_pashto.name: رازق
in_pashto.meaning: الله چې خپلو بندګانو ته روزي ورکوي
in_pashto.long_meaning: د الله تعالی یو نوم، معنی یې دا دی چې هغه خپلو بندګانو ته روزي ورکوي، دا نوم د روزي ورکولو صفت ښيي، کوم چې په اسلامي تګلارې کې مهم دی

in_english.name: Razik
in_english.meaning: One who provides sustenance, God who gives livelihood
in_english.long_meaning: One of the beautiful names of Allah, meaning the one who provides sustenance to His servants, derived from the Arabic root 'R-Z-Q', signifying abundance and provision, mentioned in the Quran as 'Ar-Razzaq' (The Provider), symbolizing Allah's power to provide for all creation, and reflecting a positive personality trait of generosity and care

data.cultural_impact: The name Razik is of Arabic origin and is quite rare in the English-speaking world. Its cultural significance can be traced back to the rich Islamic history, where knowledge and wisdom have always been cherished and highly valued. Razik may be considered the name of an individual who is respected for their deep understanding of religious and secular sciences.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Razik has a profound spiritual significance in the Islamic tradition. It signifies that the person so named has been bestowed with knowledge and wisdom by Allah. The name is an affirmation of the belief that all knowledge and understanding ultimately comes from God. Thus, anyone named Razik is encouraged to recognize the divine source of their wisdom and to use it to serve others and contribute to the betterment of their community.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The meaning "Wise, Intelligent" symbolizes Someone who is given the knowledge and wisdom by Allah. In Islamic spirituality, bearing the name Razik serves as a constant reminder of one's spiritual aspirations and connection to Islamic values of wise, intelligent.

islamic_reference.note: Traditional Islamic name with deep spiritual significance in Islamic culture

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Razik was a Persian military commander during the Sassanid Empire in the 6th century. The name Razik carried significant weight in that era.
